lines.zh: 翅膀快得只剩一团影子。
lines.en: My wings blur into a single shadow.

lines.zh: 从这朵花到那朵，只要一瞬。
lines.en: From this bloom to that one takes an instant.
Hovering costs me less than landing.

lines.zh: 草丛上方三尺，正好穿过去。
lines.en: Three feet above the grass is the perfect lane.

lines.zh: 蜂鸟飞得不慢，是你看不清。
lines.en: I am not fast; you simply cannot follow.

lines.zh: 阳光在羽毛上折出绿光。
lines.en: Sunlight folds green light off my feathers.

lines.zh: 前面那片花海，气味先到了。
lines.en: The flower field ahead arrives as scent first.
I slip past leaves without shaking off dew.

lines.zh: 丛林里光线碎，我贴低飞。
lines.en: Jungle light is broken, so I fly low.
I can turn without slowing; I have tested it.
Sunflowers stand tall, so I come in sideways.

lines.zh: 花蜜就在下面，再低一点。
lines.en: Nectar is right below; a little lower.
I dive and pull up in one motion.

lines.zh: 翅膀一秒几十下，听不清。
lines.en: Wings beat too fast for counting.

lines.zh: 我顺着风飞，翅膀少扇几下。
lines.en: I ride the wind and beat my wings less.

lines.zh: 花丛之间有条看不见的线，我走它。
lines.en: An invisible line runs between the blooms; I follow it.

lines.zh: 翅膀快到看不清，我停在花前。
lines.en: Wings too fast to see, I hover at a flower.

lines.zh: 这朵花的蜜，只够我一口。
lines.en: The nectar in this flower is one sip for me.
Slow beats save strength.

lines.zh: 前面有根枯枝，抬高一点。
lines.en: A dead branch ahead, lift a little.
The wind is from the west, I drift east.

lines.zh: 这片树太密，我的翅展不开。
lines.en: Too dense here, my wingspan will not clear.

lines.zh: 下面全是草，看得我腿软。
lines.en: Grass everywhere below, it makes my legs weak.

lines.zh: 这么小的身子，翅膀一秒几十下。
lines.en: This tiny body beats wings dozens of times a second.

lines.zh: 谁把云挪走了，花还在这。
lines.en: Who moved the clouds? The flowers are still here.
My wings are sore today.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀拍得太多，看不清花。
lines.en: My wings beat so fast the flowers blur.

lines.zh: 沿着花丛绕半圈，就回巢。
lines.en: Half a loop along the blooms and then home.
Headwind again, just endure it.
Open ground down there.
Skim the blossoms; save the wings.

lines.zh: 翅膀一快，花蜜就到我嘴里。
lines.en: One wingbeat and the nectar is mine.

lines.zh: 停在细枝上，几乎压不弯。
lines.en: Perched on a twig, I barely bend it.
My heart races, even at rest.
I smooth the feathers on my breast.
The moment a bloom opens, I must go.

lines.zh: 花朵的气味让我静下来。
lines.en: The smell of flowers quiets me.

lines.zh: 喉咙里一串细响，几乎听不见。
lines.en: A thin trill runs in my throat.

lines.zh: 太阳偏了，花蜜也换方向。
lines.en: The sun shifts, and so does the nectar.

lines.zh: 这片草地安静，蜜蜂也少。
lines.en: This meadow is calm and few bees come.

lines.zh: 翅膀还热着，先晾一会儿。
lines.en: My wings are still warm; let them cool.
The red flowers in the distance are open.

lines.zh: 我不落地，落下来就危险。
lines.en: I rarely land; on the ground I am easy prey.
When the wind rises, I hide under a leaf.
Thunder far off, the flowers will close.
What was I saying earlier?
Nothing at all up there.
Nectar on my tongue tip, very sweet.
The sun is blinding me.

lines.zh: 我记得这朵花昨天的甜度。
lines.en: I remember how sweet this flower was yesterday.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀每秒扇几十下。
lines.en: My wings beat dozens of times a second.
Something smells in the air.

lines.zh: 悬在这儿，翅膀自己会转。
lines.en: Hovering here, my wings work on their own.
When the wind stops, hovering gets hard.
Too quiet here, honestly.
My claws feel a bit numb.

lines.zh: 你站这么久，花都不敢开。
lines.en: You stand so long the flowers hesitate.

lines.zh: 你手里的瓶子，装着甜水？
lines.en: That bottle in your hand holds sweet water?
Do not raise your hand; you will scare the bees.
There is flower scent on your hat.
Since you watch, I will circle twice more.

lines.zh: 你的影子压在这丛花上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across these blossoms.

lines.zh: 你不动，我就当你是根柱子。
lines.en: Stay still and I will take you for a post.
That red cloth stands out more than flowers.
One step back, and the flowers are mine.

lines.zh: 我认得你的气味，刚才来过。
lines.en: I know your scent; you passed by earlier.
That stick of yours, point it elsewhere.
I am at the treetop and you are in the dirt.
The name's Hummingbird, remember.
I know your kind.

lines.zh: 翅膀太快，你只看见一团色。
lines.en: My wings move too fast; you see only color.
You carry a strange smell.
I hover, wings humming.
Stay away from my nest.
Hold still, there is a flower on your face.

lines.zh: 我翅膀每秒几十下，看不清吧。
lines.en: Dozens of wingbeats a second; hard to follow.
With this little blood, I cannot take two.
My wing is bent and flight is unsteady.
You hit me; that was lucky.
Two feathers fell; that is enough.
It stings numb; I must hide.
I do not fight hard; I hide.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记住你的手了。
lines.en: Now I remember that hand of yours.
Fly lower to save what strength I have.
The flower patch is the safest place.
Do not do that again.
Small as I am, I can take it.

lines.zh: 翅振得太快，羽毛都松了。
lines.en: Wings beating so fast my feathers loosen.
Wings this fast hurt most when they hit.
I can still fly.
I'll back off a bit.
You knocked two tail feathers off me.
My wing is knocked crooked, so I fly sideways.

lines.zh: 八点血，你一下就削掉一半。
lines.en: Eight hit points and you took half in one blow.
My wings — not there, please.

lines.zh: 花瓣蹭掉了我几根羽毛。
lines.en: The petals knocked a few feathers loose.
Sugar water, mixed just right.
That bottle hung by the post; I know it.
Red blossoms suit me best.
Fill the feeder and I will stay nearby.
Do not shake it, or the sugar water spills.
One flower is enough; I am not greedy.

lines.zh: 糖要化开，不然吸不上来。
lines.en: The sugar must dissolve, or I cannot sip.
Move farther off before I dare come close.
These blooms smell sweeter than yesterday.

lines.zh: 有甜味的地方，我就多转两圈。
lines.en: Where there is sweetness, I circle more.
That's nectar! I know it!
Keep your hand steady.
Even my wingtips tremble.
My wings beat so fast the flowers blur.
I've waited long for this bite.
I caught that aroma.

lines.zh: 甜得像整片花田压过来。
lines.en: So sweet it is like a whole meadow pressing in.
One drop of nectar — just one?

lines.zh: 你手里甜的，抖一点下来。
lines.en: Shake a crumb off that sweet thing.
I will trade you an iridescent feather.
I hit you and my wings stuttered.
You take up too much room; give a little.

lines.zh: 我这么轻，你几乎没感觉。
lines.en: I am so light you barely felt it.

lines.zh: 别挥手，会打断我的悬停。
lines.en: Do not wave; it breaks my hover.

lines.zh: 擦过你的肩，是没算好风。
lines.en: Clipping your shoulder was a misjudged breeze.
The flowers are over there, and you are in the way.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛掉了半根，你的错。
lines.en: Half a feather came loose; your fault.
Half a step back and the airflow clears.
You are hard, and bumping you is unpleasant.
I will circle you once, then stop bumping.

lines.zh: 你一站，我的直飞路断了。
lines.en: You stood there and cut my straight line.
Who left that on the ground?
My heart beats a dozen times a second.
Next time I'll call out first.
You don't watch the sky?
Steady now, steady now.
That's twice we've collided.
Are your eyes on your wings?
My wing grazed you, move a little.
You scattered my feathers.
Offer a flower, and that is a yes.

lines.zh: 我们并着悬停，翅膀同频。
lines.en: We hover side by side, wings in rhythm.
Fly a little higher so we do not collide.
Half of this red patch is yours.
The nest must be small, lined with moss.
The sun slants; time to head back.
Follow my tail feathers and keep up.
Spring is short, so we must hurry.
I know that gap between the branches.
Meet me under these blooms next year.
Hover with me at this flower.

lines.zh: 回我那个杯大的巢，好吗。
lines.en: Come to my cup-sized nest, yes?
My wings beat too fast to see.
Don't be shy, look up.

lines.zh: 你的翅音和我的对上了。
lines.en: Your wingbeat matches mine.
I caught you an insect.
I've made my choice.
Closer now, a bit closer.

lines.zh: 你的心跳快得和我一样。
lines.en: Your heart races as fast as mine.
I beat my wings faster than a bee.
A grain of pollen sticks to my beak.
A petal fragment goes back to the nest.
A grain of sugar fell; I pick it up.
This twig is soft enough to line the nest.
Spider silk is sticky, and useful to me.
A pinch of moss; do not scatter it.
A fallen flower still holds nectar.
This drop of water suits my throat.

lines.zh: 爪子只用来抓枝，东西得叼着。
lines.en: My feet grip twigs; cargo rides in my beak.
It is light, and flying stays easy.
I'll show my flock.
This one's shiny. Mine.
Hide it under my wing.
That glint was mine to spot first.
Heavy. I'll fly low.
A single seed is enough to carry home.

lines.zh: 这么小一朵花，够我吸一口。
lines.en: One small flower is a sip for me.
So light, one bite to hold.
Let me check whether this one holds nectar.
Gripped tight in my beak, it will not drop.
You stepped on a flower; I am watching.

lines.zh: 那只虫子靠近花心，不行。
lines.en: That insect nears the bloom's heart; no.
I am small, but I do not back off.
Up I go, then a dive.
This patch of flowers is mine today.
Keep your hand away from that blossom.
The hum of my wings is the warning.
I circle first; you had better leave.
With you here, even the bees stay away.
Small creatures keep small tempers.

lines.zh: 你踩在自己的影子上，我看得清。
lines.en: You stand in your own shadow and I see you plainly.

lines.zh: 我悬在花前，翅膀不敢停。
lines.en: I hover at the bloom, wings never still.

lines.zh: 我这么小，翅膀却停不下来。
lines.en: I'm this small, and my wings never stop.

lines.zh: 翅膀停不下来，我悬着看你。
lines.en: My wings won't stop — I hover and watch.
Wings pause half a beat, then I charge.

lines.zh: 花丛边，我的翅膀先停住了。
lines.en: By the flowers, my wings stop first.

lines.zh: 风把我托住了，正好俯冲。
lines.en: The wind holds me up, perfect for a dive.
You're locked in my sights.

lines.zh: 你比一朵花大太多，但我不怕。
lines.en: You are far bigger than a flower, but I am not afraid.
That shadow under the flower is you.
I circle right beside your ear.
You cannot swat me; I am too quick.
A pass on your left, then back again.
It is your hand I am watching.
Get closer to the flowers and I fly at your face.
If you retreat, I stop chasing.
The circle is shrinking steadily.
My hum fills the air around you.
Do not swat; swatting only draws me.

lines.zh: 你每迈一步，我就换个角度。
lines.en: Every step you take, I choose a new angle.

lines.zh: 我翅膀一秒七十下，你躲不开。
lines.en: My wings beat seventy times a second; you cannot dodge.
When you run the flowers all shake loose.
Your breathing is louder than my wings.
Hurry up, stop dawdling.

lines.zh: 你比花蜜的香气跑得快。
lines.en: You move faster than nectar scent drifts.
Your scent stays in the wind.
You slipped into the leaves. I will wait.
Don't hope for a hole.
Nectar over there — I'm watching it.
I have been hovering over your head the whole time.
A jab of my beak stings more than it looks.
I aim for your fingers.
This one is for the flower you crushed.
You thought I could not move you.
In and out fast; you cannot touch me.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇你的脸，也是攻击。
lines.en: Wings across your face count as an attack.

lines.zh: 我只啄一下，就够你记着。
lines.en: One peck, and you will remember it.
Clench your fist all you like; I still peck.
My beak is more accurate than my wings.
You stepped back twice; that will do.
One dive, and the nectar is mine.
Too late to run now.
This one hits hard.
I said I'd come down.
My beak tip just touched you.
Ha! That landed!

lines.zh: 我每秒扇五十下，你付得起吗。
lines.en: Fifty wingbeats a second; can you keep up?
Down you go now.
Move, my beak does not pick targets.
I got a mouthful of fur.
The flowers opened, so here I am.
At the jungle's edge, the light is just right.

lines.zh: 这么小一只，树都懒得理。
lines.en: So small the trees barely notice me.
First, find the reddest bloom.
The meadow wind is soft, good for hovering.
The dew has not dried, perfect for a drink.
The hive is far off; I scout ahead.

lines.zh: 影子落在地上，只有一点。
lines.en: My shadow on the ground is a dot.
Flowers everywhere, too many to choose.
Warm the wings first, then fly.
The flower forest bloomed, so here I am.
Which way is the nest?

lines.zh: 落脚了，可这里一朵花都没有。
lines.en: Landed, but there is not a single flower here.
I heard the summoning.
The world of flowers is bigger than I thought.

lines.zh: 花蜜在我舌头上淋成一线。
lines.en: Nectar runs in a line down my tongue.
I've woken up.
They call me Hummingbird.

lines.zh: 这次我想飞到雨林那边。
lines.en: This time I want to reach the jungle.
All my feathers are in place, I can fly today.
Singed feathers and I cannot fly.
My feathers curled, I cannot fly.

lines.zh: 从这么高掉下来，翅膀先护头。
lines.en: Falling this far, wings shield my head first.
My wings stopped and the grass rushed up.
I drink dew; I do not enter water.
Pull me up… glub.
The blast threw me twenty feet sideways.
The blast flipped me over.
The arrow grazed me; wind came first.
Arrow! Who shot that?
This strange tang weighs my wings down.
Nothing touched me, yet my wings went stiff.
The flowers closed and the feeder is dry.
I need one bite of something.
One thunderclap and I dropped a foot.
The sky is angry with me.
There are no flowers here, and no wind.
I can't feel my wings.
